mandatory_gates.requirement: Real observed SMS messages relevant to contemporary financial fraud/smishing and modern transactional A2P/P2P traffic.
Both confirmed fraud/smishing (n_+) and legitimate/benign (n_-) controls from a compatible, contemporaneous sampling frame.
Documented human/incident labeling rubric, adjudication protocol, inter-rater agreement or dispute resolution, and disclosed label uncertainty.
Verifiable source identity, collection timeframe/geography, lawful consent/DUA/IRB basis, and explicit license permitting evaluation.
Intact structural signals (unredacted URL hosts/TLDs, callback lures, formatting) without cross-class redaction/era shortcuts.
Verified zero/quantified exact, normalized, word 3-gram, and semantic-family overlap against Train (N=703) and Dev/Val (N=400).
Pre-registered AST-isolated quarantine with cryptographic source/artifact hashes, one-shot execution, and zero post-eval adaptation.

strict_prohibitions: No UCI + positive-only dataset stitching across eras/redaction pipelines.
No synthetic benign message balancing paired with real smishing reports.
No heuristic- or model-inferred ground truth on unlabeled SMS dumps.
No release or inspection of raw end-user PII in commits or reports.

sample_size_and_ci_framework.no_universal_n_rationale: No single universal sample size N is statistically defensible because Sensitivity/Recall uses fraud denominator n_+, Specificity/FPR uses benign denominator n_-, CI width depends on event rate p_hat (narrow near 0.95/0.01 vs widest at 0.50), cluster-correlated campaigns inflate variance by DEFF = 1 + (m - 1)*rho, and low live carrier prevalence pi amplifies small FPR errors into severe PPV degradation.

wilson_95_ci_reference_table.scenario: Recommended Class C benign floor (0 FP)

recommended_effective_sample_minimums.independent_equivalent_positives_n_plus: >= 300-500 distinct campaign-stratified smishing messages (adjust raw count upward by cluster design effect DEFF)
recommended_effective_sample_minimums.independent_equivalent_benign_n_minus: >= 1,000-2,000 contemporaneous benign A2P/P2P controls (bank alerts, OTP/2FA, carrier notices, delivery, conversational) to bound rare false-block upper CI below 0.4% and protect PPV at pi <= 1%

routes_investigated.name: NCSU WSPR SMS Phishing Dataset (IEEE S&P '24)
routes_investigated.owner_or_provider: Wolfpack Security and Privacy Research (WSPR) Lab, NC State University + PayPal co-authors
routes_investigated.paper_reference: Nahapetyan et al., 'On SMS Phishing Tactics and Infrastructure', IEEE S&P 2024
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: English & international messages scraped from public receive-SMS gateways flagged by VirusTotal (>=3 vendors), APWG, or Google Safe Browsing (~200M raw pool filtered to 68,029 flagged messages across 35,128 campaigns).
routes_investigated.geography_and_timeframe: Global / primarily US & Western gateway numbers (2022-05-01 to 2023-06-01 UTC)
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Automated URL-intelligence labeling (>=3 VirusTotal AV detections, APWG, or Google Safe Browsing). Non-flagged gateway texts discarded because low vendor hits cannot certify benign ground truth; excludes zero-link smishing/vishing/OTP-only lures.
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: MIT License (`LICENSE` verified in repo); collected from public free receive-SMS gateway webpages (`sha256` `phishing_messages.csv` = d125c394af792faeb2b71b3f7100cad3b4cece02aff78cb4ec1fb9e7db90f230, `12,762,328` bytes).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: Unredacted URLs preserved (`13,088` `https?://` matches; `0` Presidio `<URL>` tags), but biased toward public disposable-number OTP/test traffic and URL-bearing lures only.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Positive-only dataset (0 benign negatives): cannot estimate FPR, Specificity, or Tier-2 false blocks.
Public disposable SMS-gateway sampling bias & URL-feed labeling exclude non-URL callback/conversational smishing.
routes_investigated.next_actionable_step: Retain strictly as candidate future unredacted URL-smishing stress corpus if ever evaluated separately; do not use as Class C holdout or pair with unrelated negatives.

routes_investigated.name: Super SMS Dataset (smspamresearch/spstudy, IEEE Access '24)
routes_investigated.paper_reference: Salman et al., IEEE Access 2024 (document/10431737; preprint arXiv:2210.10451)
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: Consolidated 2012-2024 CSV merging UCI SMS Spam Collection, NUS SMS Corpus, SpamHunter Twitter OCR, ScamWatch, UK Action Fraud, and public repositories.
routes_investigated.geography_and_timeframe: Mixed Singapore (2013-2015 NUS), UK (2002-2011 UCI), global Twitter/scam feeds (2012-2024)
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Inherited binary labels (`0`: 40,830; `1`: 26,178; `''`: 2). Direct audit found `34,786` label-0 rows come from NUS SMS Corpus + `3,748` from UCI `ham` (= `94.4%` pre-2015 student P2P chat) plus 1 UCI `spam` row mislabeled as `0`.
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: NO repository LICENSE file (`license: None` on GitHub); mixes third-party scraped/user corpora (`super_sms_dataset.csv` `sha256` = ba825b468b59fb229cc56c15a6c2d14d593a88051d54ea2f402166bf2ab894d3).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: Severe domain/era confounding: only `4 / 40,830` (`0.0098%`) label-0 messages contain `https?://` vs. `5,231 / 26,178` (`19.98%`) label-1 messages, and `2,343` `<...>` NUS placeholders occur almost exclusively in label `0`.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: No OSI/Creative Commons redistribution license on repository (`license: None`).
94.4% of 'benign' negatives originate from 2002-2015 student P2P chat (NUS + UCI) with near-zero URLs (4/40,830), creating extreme shortcut confounding against URL-bearing scams (5,231/26,178).
routes_investigated.next_actionable_step: Do not ingest; reject permanently as primary Class C holdout.

routes_investigated.name: SpamHunter Twitter-Guided SMS Spam Dataset (USENIX Security '22)
routes_investigated.paper_reference: Tang et al., 'Clues in Tweets: Twitter-Guided Discovery and Analysis of SMS Spam', USENIX Security 2022
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: SMS screenshots mined from Twitter/X posts (2018-2022) via OCR plus labeled subset `train/tweet_spam_labeelled.csv`.
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Labeled sample (`947` rows: `Fraud=587`, `Ads=360`) relies on machine/author translation and OCR from screenshots; `0` benign negatives.
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: NO repository license (`license: None` on GitHub).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: README explicitly documents 'spam sms texts with numbers removed', plus OCR transcription noise and non-verbatim English translations.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: No repository license (`license: None`), positive-only (0 benign negatives), phone-number redaction, and OCR/translation artifacts.

routes_investigated.name: ExAIS_SMS Indigenous SMS Corpus (Abayomi-Alli et al., 2022)
routes_investigated.paper_reference: DOI: 10.1002/cpe.6989 (Concurrency and Computation: Practice and Experience, 2022)
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: 20 university community participants (students, faculty, staff aged 20-50) donating mobile inbox SMS.
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Generic `SPAM` (`2,350`) vs `HAM` (`2,890`) inbox labeling; includes regional telecom promotional spam rather than modern US/global bank smishing (`15` exact normalized overlaps with UCI #228; `0` with Train/DevVal).
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: NO license file on canonical GitHub repo (`license: None`; downstream Kaggle mirrors assert Apache 2.0 without upstream authorization).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: Manual PII masking (`***`/`xxx` present in `360 / 5,240` rows); only `63` messages contain `http(s)://` URLs.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Canonical GitHub repository lacks an explicit open-source/Creative Commons license.
2013-2016 regional `SPAM`/`HAM` labels plus manual `***`/`xxx` account/phone masking fail modern fraud label & unredacted signal requirements.

routes_investigated.name: Financial Scams Detection Dataset (Mendeley znsk27yk3h.2, 2025)
routes_investigated.owner_or_provider: Al Rafi Ahmed & Gazi Faizul Islam (Mendeley Data)
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: University students & public submissions collected via Google Forms, handwritten submissions, mobile SMS, chat apps, and emails.
routes_investigated.language_scope: Bilingual Bangla & English (`119 / 523` rows contain non-ASCII characters; ~404 ASCII rows)
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Author-labeled `scam` (`310`) vs `ham` (`213`); mixed modality (`SMS`, `chat`, `email`, handwritten forms) and unverified collection/adjudication rubric (`2` rows match UCI).
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: Mendeley API returns `data_licence: None` / `license: None` on v2 despite CC BY 4.0 claims in search summaries (`sha256` = 58ec802e4de8768643e3be0badbaedb3ae5017a273e8f3898e72f6a29cbc96ad, `47,442` bytes).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: Description states personal names, phone numbers, account numbers, and emails were removed/anonymized.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Mixed channels (Google Forms, handwritten entries, chat, email, SMS) prevent pure SMS channel evaluation.
API metadata omits explicit license (`None`), anonymizes contact/URL/phone entities, and provides only ~404 ASCII rows total.

routes_investigated.name: Kaggle SMS-Data (Financial Health Information Extraction Dataset)
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: 100,243 raw mobile SMS logs synced across `93` distinct user IDs/masked `phoneNumber` accounts (`8,929` `senderAddress` IDs), nominally 'riders' for loan/financial underwriting.
routes_investigated.geography_and_timeframe: India / South Asia + English financial alerts (`87,188` ASCII rows; `May` timestamps without year)
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: ZERO ground-truth labels (`columns: ['phoneNumber', 'id', 'updateAt', 'senderAddress', 'text']`). Unfiltered mobile inboxes mix bank alerts, marketing promo spam, OTPs, and unflagged scams (`68` rows match UCI SMS Spam normalized hashes!).
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: Tagged `CC0: Public Domain` on Kaggle, but contains no ethics approval, IRB record, or verifiable end-user consent documentation permitting third-party secondary benchmarking (`8,945` rows contain `****`/`XXXX` masking).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: `28,560` raw `https?://` URLs preserved alongside partial `*`/`X` masking on account/OTP digits (`8,945` rows). Inferring benign vs. fraud via heuristics or rules is strictly prohibited.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Unlabeled raw mobile inbox dump (0 verified benign or fraud labels; contains mixed promo spam including 68 UCI overlaps).
No documented end-user informed consent, IRB approval, or collection protocol validating lawful redistribution despite CC0 tag.
routes_investigated.next_actionable_step: Do not ingest or pseudo-label via rules/models.

routes_investigated.name: Electric Sheep Africa Smishing / SMS Phishing (Hugging Face)
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: 10,000 tabular rows; direct `datasets-server` inspection confirmed `is_synthetic = 1` on `94 / 100` first-100 rows alongside `license: other`.
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Synthetic text + fabricated victim demographics synthesized against summary reports.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Synthetic dataset (`is_synthetic=1`); prohibited as Class C observation.

routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: Non-English simulated data + email/SMS channel mix.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Simulated non-observed data in Vietnamese mixing SMS and email.

routes_investigated.name: MNO 7726 User-Reported SMS Corpus & IMC '25 Team (arXiv:2508.05276)
routes_investigated.owner_or_provider: Agarwal, Suarez-Tangil & Vasek (UCL / IMDEA Software) with collaborating Mobile Network Operator
routes_investigated.paper_reference: 'An Overview of 7726 User Reports: Uncovering SMS Scams and Scammer Strategies' (arXiv:2508.05276v2, Nov 2025)
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: 1.35M consumer 7726 spam/scam forwards received by a major MNO over 4 months (`89.16%` SMS; `35.12%` generic spam vs `40.27%` scams across 12 categories with Cohen kappa 0.71-0.84). No public data URL is released.
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: High-quality spam vs. scam taxonomy with documented IRR (kappa 0.71-0.84), but user-reported 7726 submissions contain almost exclusively suspicious/unwanted traffic — no routine benign A2P/P2P negative control slice is published.
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: Strictly governed by collaborating MNO 7726 service terms, departmental ethics approval, and MNO PII redaction agreement (MNO strips reporter identity & replaces full URLs with domains where PII may appear).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: URL query/path PII scrubbed to domain-level by MNO; still lacks unflagged benign negatives (`n_-`) unless the MNO pairs stratified random benign traffic inside an enclave.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Private MNO data under DUA/ethics restrictions (not publicly accessible without formal MNO agreement).
User-reported 7726 corpus excludes legitimate non-reported SMS negatives (`n_- = 0`) and truncates PII-bearing URLs to domains.
routes_investigated.next_actionable_step: Requires institutional IRB + MNO Data Use Agreement explicitly pairing 7726-confirmed scams with contemporaneously sampled benign A2P/P2P traffic inside an enclave.

routes_investigated.name: SmishTank Academic Author Collaboration (arXiv:2402.18430 / CODASPY '24)
routes_investigated.owner_or_provider: Timko & Rahman (California State University San Marcos)
routes_investigated.paper_reference: 'Smishing Dataset I: Phishing SMS Dataset from Smishtank.com', ACM CODASPY 2024
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: Re-probe verified `https://smishtank.com/` returns HTTP 200 (886 bytes), while `https://smishtank.com/dataset` returns HTTP 404 (no public static download).
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Community-submitted smishing reports with VirusTotal/WHOIS enrichment; positive-only (`0` benign negatives).
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: Preprint carries CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (NonCommercial); commercial/open evaluation permissions require explicit author DUA.
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: Reported as containing raw body/URL/brand attributes, though static dataset endpoint is unavailable (`404`).
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: Public dataset endpoint returns HTTP 404; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 preprint is non-commercial and requires direct CSUSM author agreement.
Positive-only (~1,090 smishing, 0 benign negatives): cannot qualify alone as a two-class Class C holdout.
routes_investigated.next_actionable_step: Secondary positive-only option via CSUSM author DUA only if paired non-confoundingly — cannot unblock Class C alone.

routes_investigated.name: US Regulatory Channels (FCC CGB Open Data, FTC Consumer Sentinel, CFPB API)

routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: USGOV_WORKS public domain (FCC/CFPB public fields); raw consumer complaints with PII are FOIA-protected / law-enforcement only (FTC Sentinel).
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: FCC open feed has zero SMS message bodies; CFPB narratives contain prose essays with `XXXX` redactions.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: No verbatim SMS bodies exposed (FCC open schema omits text; CFPB stores redacted prose essays; FTC Consumer Sentinel excludes non-law-enforcement researchers).
Zero benign negative SMS control stream.
routes_investigated.next_actionable_step: Do not pursue US public regulator dumps for SMS text evaluation.

routes_investigated.name: Industry Consortia & Privacy-Preserving Carrier/CPaaS Telemetry Enclave (APWG eCX, M3AAWG, GSMA Foundry / Direct MNO Partner)
routes_investigated.owner_or_provider: APWG (eCX Research Grant), M3AAWG (Academic Membership), GSMA Foundry, Direct Carrier / CPaaS Partner
routes_investigated.paper_reference: APWG Cybercrime Researcher Data Grant (`membership@apwg.org`), M3AAWG Institutional Membership, GSMA Foundry & Direct MNO Enclave Protocol
routes_investigated.population_and_sampling: Structured access path: APWG eCX provides lab-grade phishing URL/threat APIs under proposal review; M3AAWG/GSMA Foundry connect messaging operators via sponsored membership/DUA; a direct Carrier or CPaaS shadow enclave can sample contemporaneous legitimate transactional A2P/P2P SMS (`n_-`) alongside adjudicated fraud/7726-confirmed smishing (`n_+`).
routes_investigated.geography_and_timeframe: US / Global Tier-1 Carrier & CPaaS A2P/P2P traffic (current / prospective)
routes_investigated.label_methodology_and_uncertainty: Requires pre-registered adjudication protocol combining human abuse-ops verdicts, confirmed CDR/complaint dispositions, and random benign sampling across transactional categories (bank alerts, OTP/2FA, delivery, retail, P2P) with cluster IDs.
routes_investigated.license_terms_and_privacy: Requires formal DUA, GDPR/CCPA/ECPA privacy review, ethics sign-off, and preferably in-enclave zero-export execution over frozen ONNX model hashes.
routes_investigated.content_integrity_and_redaction: Only enclave deployment or reversible tokenized host-preserving evaluation can keep URLs, sender IDs, and formatting cues unconfounded without exposing raw end-user PII outside operator custody.
rejection_or_blocker_reasons: No active DUA, institutional membership sponsor, or live carrier/CPaaS enclave currently exists in this repository.
APWG eCX primarily covers URLs/phishing feeds and GSMA Scam Signal exchanges network session signals rather than raw SMS text bodies.
routes_investigated.next_actionable_step: Primary viable path to unblock Class C / Class D: secure a signed MNO/CPaaS/fintech DUA + privacy-preserving evaluation enclave sampling both stratified benign transactional SMS (n_- >= 1,000 i.i.d.-eq) and adjudicated smishing (n_+ >= 300-500 i.i.d.-eq) for a single-shot run against frozen ONNX SHA-256 d330466e...
